changes.title: Fewer paths
items: Far fewer footpaths and at most one railway per map

changes.title: Sigils through
items: Placed sigils show faintly through grass, bushes and trees, so you can always find them
A parked animal no longer shows a second sigil over it from the treetops when it wanders off

changes.title: Night won
items: Win the night: after the last wave a 🎉 pointer leads you to the last angry animals, then the victory lap races home with fireworks at every stone
The island won: the night's legends wake and dance at home, every animal joins one giant conga line, and a Night won card lists the islands you found
